description: Low-latency mechanical keyboard and mouse sound simulator with customizable soundpacks.
notes: Uses Scoop's Inno Setup extraction to unpack the official installer payload; the native setup is not run, so its Start Menu entries and registry installation steps are not applied.
Settings and soundpacks are stored under %APPDATA%\Mechvibes. This manifest does not redirect that data to D:.
Use 'scoop update mechvibes-dx' to update this installation. Avoid the app's in-app installer updater while managed by Scoop, because the upstream setup is not Scoop-aware.
